neighbours.label: the body maintaining or regulating its own functions (maintain, control of, immune, in physiology)
fire: The kidneys help maintain the balance of salts in the blood.
Vitamin D plays a key role in maintaining healthy bones.
The hypothalamus is involved in control of body temperature.
A strong immune system protects the body from infection.
Insulin regulates the uptake of glucose by muscle cells.
The cell membrane controls the passage of nutrients into the cell.
Sleep supports normal repair of tissues and organs.
The liver is essential for maintaining stable blood sugar levels.
quiet: The landlord helps maintain the boilers in the apartment block.
Regular oiling plays a key role in maintaining a bicycle chain.
The thermostat is involved in control of the office heating.
A strong security system protects the building from intruders.
The new manager regulates the hours of the warehouse staff.
The border agency controls the passage of trucks into the country.
The grant supports normal repair of roads and bridges.
The city council is responsible for maintaining the public parks.

notes: Card: 'control of metabolism', 'kidneys maintain', 'maintaining cardiovascular health', ' immune' x7. Near misses keep the maintain/control wording outside the body.
